meta.source: Kidos logo (sticker badge) + 2026 price list site

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is a cool, blue-leaning white taken from the logo's sky; dark is the navy outline colour pushed to night.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, package tiles, tab bar, phone pill. The white sticker border of the logo.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells inside cards: the feature list of a PackageCard, input fields.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text and headings on ground, surface and surface-sunk (16:1+ in both themes). In light it is the logo's navy outline.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: taglines, meta lines, captions, on ground, surface and surface-sunk (7.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The sticker outline: 3px stroke around stickers, candy buttons and the slogan ribbon, and the colour of the candy drop-shadow. Navy in both themes; in dark it is carried by the white ring around it.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Kidos Pink: cap brim, the logo's inner ring, the letters ד and י. Primary action fill (with on-pink at 19px+ bold), price numerals, highlights. Also reads as text on the dark ground (4.8:1).

tokens.name: pink-deep
tokens.usage: Pink as small text or small fills with white text (5.4:1 on white). In dark it lightens to stay readable on ground (5.9:1).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Kidos Blue: the disc behind the character. Secondary button fill (white text 5.3:1), the Tabs active state, the header band.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The cap. Decorative fills, spark ticks, focus ring (3.6:1 on white, 5:1 on dark ground). Never body text on light grounds.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text-only buttons on ground and surface (4.9:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Kidos Lime: the outer ring and the shirt. Badge fills, 'included' ticks, the celebrating accent. Always with ink-navy text on it (11:1), never white.

tokens.name: lime-deep
tokens.usage: The shaded lime of the letters ס and ו. Borders and pressed states of lime elements; not a text colour.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The star on the cap. The single 'best value' flag per view, star icons, confetti. Navy text only (13:1).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Skin tone of the character. Warm tint for notes and the 'package perk' strip, with ink text (13:1).

tokens.name: tangerine
tokens.usage: Shading on the thumb. Decorative only (confetti, illustration shading); never a text or status colour.

tokens.name: on-pink
tokens.usage: Text on pink fills. Only at 19px+ bold (3.8:1, large-text rule); smaller text goes on pink-deep instead.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue and pink-deep fills (5.3:1+).

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text on lime, sun and peach fills.

tokens.name: ribbon
tokens.usage: The navy slogan ribbon under the wordmark ('אירועים שלא שוכחים!'). White text on it (17:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The price on a PackageCard, in pink. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: בובת ענק לבחירה, הרקדה שמחה וצילומים.
styles.usage: Running text and feature lists. Hebrew needs the taller 28px line.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges; spark tick length.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; list row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones; gaps inside a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inputs, the feature well inside a card.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons that are not pills, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Cards and package tiles: as soft as the logo's letters.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, the slogan ribbon, the phone pill, tabs.

tokens.name: shadow-candy
tokens.usage: The solid navy drop under candy buttons and stickers; pressed state moves the element down 4px and removes it.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Cards on hover and the sticky tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Sticker frame: navy outline, white ring, navy outline, like the logo's badge edge. For round photos and the logo badge.

tokens.name: stroke-outline
tokens.usage: Sticker outline width on buttons, ribbon and stickers.

tokens.name: stroke-ring
tokens.usage: White gap ring between outline and a coloured ring.
